papers.title: Symmetry-Based Evaluation of Tool Coating Effects on the Machining Behavior of Ti-6Al-4V Using Micro-EDM
papers.abstract: Titanium alloy Ti-6Al-4V possesses excellent mechanical and corrosion-resistant properties; therefore, it is widely employed in aerospace, automotive, and biomedical fields. However, its poor machinability restricts traditional processing methods. To overcome this limitation, the current work presents a symmetry analysis approach to evaluate the effects of tool coating on the micro-electric discharge machining (micro-EDM) characteristics of Ti-6Al-4V. Tungsten carbide (WC) microelectrodes were fabricated in three forms: uncoated, copper-coated, and carbon-coated. The chemical vapor deposition (CVD) method was used to coat the carbon layer, and the integrity of the coating was confirmed by Energy-Dispersive X-ray Spectroscopy/Analysis (EDS/EDX). The effect of input variables—namely, voltage, capacitance, and spindle rotational speed—on two responses was studied—the machining depth (Z-axis displacement) and tool wear rate (TWR)—using a Taguchi L9 orthogonal array. Analysis conducted using Minitab statistical software 17 revealed that both voltage and capacitance contributed to the response parameters as optimized variables. The comparative study showed that the copper- and carbon-coated WC microtool could obtain a better Z coordinate and lower tool wear ratio compared with those of the uncoated tool. The findings confirm that applying thin conductive coatings to WC tools can significantly improve the stability, precision, and overall symmetry of the micro-EDM process when machining difficult-to-cut titanium alloys.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及Ti-6Al-4V的微电火花加工，但未评估后处理对疲劳或力学性能的影响。
llm.why_not_core: no evaluation of mechanical performance (fatigue, tensile) after post-processing; only studies machining process parameters.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估刀具涂层对Ti-6Al-4V微电火花加工的影响。
summary_zh.method: 采用田口L9正交实验，对比无涂层、铜涂层和碳涂层WC微电极。
summary_zh.result: 涂层刀具提高了加工深度并降低了工具磨损率。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验测量加工深度和工具磨损率验证。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the effect of tool coating on the micro-EDM machining characteristics of Ti-6Al-4V.
summary_en.method: Taguchi L9 orthogonal array with uncoated, copper-coated, and carbon-coated tungsten carbide microelectrodes.
summary_en.result: Coated tools improved machining depth and reduced tool wear ratio compared to uncoated tools.
summary_en.validation: Experimental measurement of depth and tool wear rate under varying voltage, capacitance, and spindle speed.

papers.title: A novel L-BFGS-B optimized machine learning model for predicting tensile strength of SLM-manufactured Ti-6Al-4V alloys
papers.first_author_affiliation: APJ Abdul Kalam Technological University, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, India

corresponding_authors.name: B. S. Arun
corresponding_authors.affiliation: APJ Abdul Kalam Technological University, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, India

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文直接针对SLM制造的Ti-6Al-4V合金的抗拉强度预测，与用户关注的力学性能方向高度吻合。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not provide new experimental mechanical data but instead proposes a predictive model using existing data, which is still within the scope of L1 since modeling work is accepted.

summary_zh.motivation: 优化机器学习模型以提高SLM制造Ti-6Al-4V合金抗拉强度的预测精度。
summary_zh.method: 采用L-BFGS-B优化算法训练机器学习模型，基于工艺参数预测抗拉强度。
summary_zh.result: 模型预测精度显著高于传统回归方法，为工艺优化提供支持。
summary_zh.validation: 与文献实验数据对比验证预测准确性。

summary_en.motivation: To enhance the prediction accuracy of tensile strength for SLM-produced Ti-6Al-4V alloys by optimizing a machine learning model.
summary_en.method: An L-BFGS-B optimized machine learning model is developed to predict tensile strength based on process parameters.
summary_en.result: The optimized model achieves significantly higher prediction accuracy compared to conventional regression methods, offering guidance for process optimization.
summary_en.validation: The model is validated against experimental tensile strength data from literature.
